,YDAB.BANK_ID AS YTD_BANK_ID

,LEFT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 5) AS YTD_BNK_CODE
,RIGHT(LEFT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 9), 3) AS YTD_SOURCE_CODE
,YDAB.FILE_NAME AS YTD_FILE_NAME
,YDAB.insert_dttm AS YTD_insert_dttm
,LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS YTD_Business_Date

------CURRENCY CONVERSION------
,EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
,0 AS PREVIOUS_MONTHEND_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE
,CAST(YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120)) AS DECIMAL(25,4)) YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL
      ELSE EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL * BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(25,4)) OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,0 AS PREVIOUS_MONTHEND_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120))
      ELSE (YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10), LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120))) * BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
,DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120)) AS DAY_OF_YEAR 
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN 1 ELSE BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(15,10)) CONVERSION_RATE


------OTHER------
,'NA' AS MONTH_YEAR
,'NA' AS MTD_BANK_ID
,'NA' AS MTD_SOL_ID
,'NA' AS MTD_SCHM_CODE
,'NA' AS MTD_SCHM_TYPE

,'NA' AS USERID
,'1900-01-01' AS MTD_LCHG_TIME
,'NA' AS QUARTER_YEAR
,'NA' AS MTD_LAST6_ACC_NUM
,'NA' AS MTD_BNK_CODE
,'NA' AS MTD_SOURCE_CODE
,'NA' AS MTD_FILE_NAME
,'1900-01-01' AS MTD_INSERT_DTTM

,LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS As_Of_Date

FROM (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL WHERE H = 'D') GAM
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL WHERE H = 'D') EAB 
ON GAM.ACID = EAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = EAB.BANK_ID
AND LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) = LEFT(RIGHT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL WHERE H = 'D') YDAB
ON GAM.ACID = YDAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = YDAB.BANK_ID
AND LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) = LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8)
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.currencyconversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' ) BCC ON 
LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
AND GAM.BANK_ID = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId


)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DEPOSITS_FACT FROM TEMP_DEPOSITS_FACT;
